title: JustinGuitar Lesson 3 Practice Routine – 20-Minute Structured Practice Focus (A minor / E minor)
summary: This lesson guides a beginner through a compact 20-minute practice routine centered on the A minor and E minor chords. It starts with chord-perfect practice for clean voicings, then progresses through a sequence of one-minute chord-change drills (A minor to E, E minor to D, and A minor to E minor), followed by a focused anchor-finger drill. A 2-minute strumming segment emphasizes a relaxed arm and steady pick technique, then a 2-minute riff practice on Seven Nation Army targets muting and string awareness. The session concludes with 10 minutes of song practice using the two-chord progression, offering song choices (Sing, Moves Like Jagger, I Belong To You) and guidance on pacing, chord-change speed targets, and the optional use of the Beginner Song Course app to build timing and confidence.
